notes.title: Dream Gen - Zen Mode
notes.content:
User Interface overhaul

 control of all parameters while playing polyrhythm
 redesigned layout
 new look and feel to UI elements
 new sliders and dials for easier preset creation
 customisable interface, with movable parameter windows
 right click notes/chords/BPM for the traditional manual control

 2 Brand new presets (sleepy & stars)
 Fixed major bug for regions that use commas as the decimal place notation
 Other minor bugfixes
